name: Band Spanish Squat
steps: Anchor a heavy resistance band at knee height, step both legs into the loop just behind your knees, and step back to pull it taut.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and lean your weight slightly back into the band's support.
Squat smoothly downward with vertical shins and an upright torso until your thighs approach parallel to the floor.
Drive firmly through your feet and squeeze your quads at the top while keeping constant tension against the band.
tips: Keep your shins vertical and trust the heavy band to counterbalance your upright torso.
Use a thick, sturdy band anchored securely so it stays snug behind your knees throughout the set.
